title: Linden Sideboard
tagline: Fluted oak doors that catch the light

content.text: Linden's doors are fluted by hand on the router table, one groove at a time. As the light moves through the room, the surface shifts from soft to sharp.
Behind the doors are adjustable shelves and a cable opening at the back, so it works as well for records and a turntable as it does for plates and glasses.

care: Wipe with a soft, damp cloth and dry straight away. Re-oil once or twice a year with the care kit included.
